summary: Visual regression check after full monochrome dark-theme redesign. Scanned every major surface with a programmatic foreground/background luminance-ratio check plus screenshots. Dark theme is PRISTINE (0 contrast issues on Landing full-scroll, /pricing, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /cookies, 404, Login, 2FA, Signup, Forgot, Onboarding, and all 12 dashboard pages: Dashboard, Leads, Research, Campaigns, Emails, Calls, Meetings, CRM, Analytics, Automation, Knowledge, Integrations, Settings). Hero, Trusted-By row, white pill CTAs, ghost buttons, Most Popular pricing badge, CRM kanban, Analytics greyscale charts, Settings > Billing card, Research company banner, Automation canvas all render correctly. Functional flow (login prefilled -> 2FA OTP -> /app) works. Two regressions found: (1) LIGHT theme on Landing nav has WHITE-ON-WHITE 'LeadPilot AI' logo text and 'Log in' button (invisible); (2) AI assistant panel testids missing after FAB click.

ui_bugs.issue: 'LeadPilot AI' logo <span> has color rgb(255,255,255) but light-theme nav bg is white/near-white -> logo is invisible in light theme. Ratio ~1.0.
nav-login-btn 'Log in' button computed color rgb(255,255,255) on transparent nav (renders white on white). Ratio ~1.0. Invisible in light theme.

After clicking [data-testid='ai-assistant-fab'] the review spec expects ai-assistant-input + ai-assistant-send inside an opened panel. Only testids present post-click that match are: assistant-nav-btn, ai-assistant-fab. ai-assistant-input and ai-assistant-send NOT found in DOM. Panel may not actually open, or those testids were removed during the restyle.

issues: Top nav LeadPilot AI logo + Log in button invisible on white background — light-theme palette not applied to these two nav items during the dark-first redesign.

action_items: Fix light-theme Landing nav: give the 'LeadPilot AI' logo span and nav-login-btn a dark foreground when :root is light (e.g. text-foreground / text-neutral-900 instead of hard-coded text-white).

Verify AI assistant floating panel: ensure clicking ai-assistant-fab actually opens the panel and that the message input has data-testid='ai-assistant-input' and send button has data-testid='ai-assistant-send' as advertised.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing nav appears to hard-code text-white on the logo span and Log in link (survived the palette migration to greyscale) — should use CSS variable/token like text-foreground so it inverts when theme=light.

Auth pages (Login/Signup/Forgot) inputs and labels are legible in dark; verified inputs use color:white on transparent inside a black panel. Confirm they still work in light theme if the auth shell ever supports the toggle.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (dark theme 100%; light theme has 2 invisible nav elements; AI panel testids missing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Default theme is DARK and works fully. Regression is in LIGHT theme only on Landing nav (logo + login button white-on-white). AI FAB opens something but does not expose ai-assistant-input / ai-assistant-send testids. Contrast test JS used foreground/background luminance ratio < 1.5 threshold across all visible text nodes with own text. 2FA input uses a single OTP composite; use [data-testid='twofa-form'] input and page.keyboard.type('123456'). Direct navigation to /app works without going through login (no route guard). Onboarding auto-skipped if already completed in localStorage.
rca of the issue: During the monochrome palette migration to dark-first, the Landing nav's brand logo text and secondary 'Log in' link kept hard-coded text-white classes (or text-primary-foreground mapped to white). Theme toggle switches --background to white but does not invert those hard-coded utility classes. Fix: replace text-white on these nav items with a token-aware class such as text-foreground so they turn black in light and white in dark automatically. AI FAB regression likely occurred if the AssistantPanel component's input/send elements lost their data-testid attrs, or if the FAB now routes to /app instead of opening an inline panel.
